sloka: अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैः सूर्य सन्निभैः ।त्यक्त्वा देहान् नवैर् देहैः स्वर् याताः परम ऋषयः ॥३-११-९२॥
transliteration: atra siddhā mahātmāno vimānaiḥ sūrya sannibhaiḥ ।tyaktvā dehān navair dehaiḥ svar yātāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥3-11-92॥

translations.english: Here great souls like sages and siddhas gave up the ghost and with renewed bodies left for heaven on aerochariot resembling the Sun (in brightness).
